title: Generating Adversarial Events: A Motion-Aware Point Cloud Framework
abstract: arXiv:2602.08230v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Event cameras have been widely adopted in safety-critical domains such as autonomous driving, robotics, and human-computer interaction. A pressing challenge arises from the vulnerability of deep neural networks to adversarial examples, which poses a significant threat to the reliability of event-based systems. Nevertheless, research into adversarial attacks on events is scarce. This is primarily due to the non-differentiable nature of mainstream event representations, which hinders the extension of gradient-based attack methods. translated_title: 生成对抗事件：一种运动感知的点云框架
translated_abstract: 事件相机已被广泛应用于自动驾驶、机器人和人机交互等安全关键领域。深度神经网络对对抗样本的脆弱性带来了一个紧迫的挑战，这对基于事件的系统的可靠性构成了重大威胁。然而，针对事件数据的对抗攻击研究却十分匮乏。这主要是由于主流事件表示具有不可微分的特性，阻碍了基于梯度的攻击方法的扩展。在本文中，我们提出了MA-ADV，一种新颖的运动感知对抗框架。据我们所知，这是首个利用点云表示来生成对抗事件的工作。MA-ADV考虑了事件中的高频噪声，并采用基于扩散的方法来平滑扰动，同时充分利用空间和时间关系（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出了首个基于点云表示生成对抗事件的运动感知对抗框架MA-ADV，利用扩散方法平滑扰动并充分建模时空关系，填补了事件相机对抗攻击研究的空白。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MA-ADV, the first motion-aware adversarial framework to generate adversarial events via point cloud representations, employing a diffusion-based approach to smooth perturbations while leveraging spatial-temporal relationships.
